name: Medical sealed terrazzo
brief: MEDICAL: medium warm-grey matte sealed terrazzo composite with sparse broad ivory aggregate flecks, very fine muted jade gasket trim, large quiet square centers; a few square flush maintenance lids and subtle rounded inset borders. Not speckled visual noise. Clean clinical maintained surface.
prompt: Create ONE square opaque production game FLOOR TILE ATLAS for BrineSpace, a quiet retro-industrial underwater station. EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows, sixteen equal square tiles filling image edge to edge. Straight shared grid boundaries at 25%,50%,75%. No gutters or external border. Matching narrow neutral dark gaskets on every tile edge for rearrangement. Strict flat top-down orthographic floor, no perspective, walls or upright objects. 16 compatible tile variations with mostly quiet solid centers, selective functional construction details and crisp deliberate pixel-art clusters. Everything flush with floor. Medium-low contrast, diffuse light, matte finishes, small sparse midtone edges. No white outlines, shine, chrome, sparkle, glow, photographic noise, dense scratches, text, labels, arrows, furniture, loose objects or scenery. Texture should read beneath existing detailed room machines at a 48-unit tile size. Single usable atlas, not a presentation sheet. Request 1024x1024.
